import json
import pdf_ops

PAGE = 7
TARGET_TEXT = 'for reference only'
NEAR = [74.03, 631.99, 484.34, 658.51]
REPLACEMENT = 'for general reference purposes only'

doc = pdf_ops.open("input.pdf")
target = pdf_ops.find_target(doc, PAGE, TARGET_TEXT, near=NEAR)

ok, missing = pdf_ops.glyphs_available(target.font, REPLACEMENT)
if not ok:
    raise pdf_ops.MissingGlyphsError("characters missing from the embedded font", missing)
BOUNDARY = 521.988
MAX_BOTTOM = 42.061
fit = pdf_ops.fit_reflow(doc, target, REPLACEMENT, boundary=BOUNDARY, max_bottom=MAX_BOTTOM)
if not fit.feasible:
    raise pdf_ops.DoesNotFitError(fit.reason)
result = pdf_ops.reflow_paragraph(doc, target, REPLACEMENT, boundary=BOUNDARY, max_bottom=MAX_BOTTOM)
pdf_ops.save(doc, "output.pdf")
print(json.dumps(result.to_dict()))
